bed_reason: Every official Dawn of War IV trailer on the Steam page carries speech under the picture: Adeptus Mechanicus Gameplay Trailer (narrated throughout, music stem only 9 percent of the track, a second separation pass still heard 11.9 percent leakage, so the clean-stem test failed), Gameplay Overview Trailer (8.7 minute developer walkthrough with voice), Skulls Trailer (narrated 1 to 115 s), Space Marines CGI Trailer (dialogue and a monologue), Necrons CGI Trailer (monologue), Ork Faction Trailer (narrated), Story Trailer, ANNOUNCE and IN-Engine trailers (voice lines and unit barks), Dark Angels Trailer (battle shouts), Battlefield Reports (developer talking); none has a stretch with music and no voice, so the Reel runs our bed

angle.hook: Dawn of War IV needs 125 GB of free space on PC, per the official specs on its Steam page
angle.why_now: the official PC requirements went up on Steam on 12 Nov 20:59 Dubai, three weeks before the 3 Dec launch
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf PC players can check their GPU and disk before the 30 Nov early access and 3 Dec launch; the AED price is on the UAE Steam store; GeForce NOW is confirmed
angle.payoff: minimum GTX 1660 and 16 GB RAM, recommended RTX 3060 Ti and 32 GB, Windows 11, 125 GB, early access 30 Nov for Commander Edition owners
